name: Sit-Up Reach

frames.label: Start
frames.cue: Lie back with knees bent, feet flat and arms overhead.

frames.label: Arms Forward
frames.cue: Sweep your arms forward and gently lift your shoulders.

frames.label: Lift
frames.cue: Continue lifting with control and keep your feet grounded.

frames.label: Full Reach
frames.cue: Reach toward your knees or shins without pulling your neck.

frames.label: Controlled Lower
frames.cue: Lower slowly through the middle position.

frames.label: Reset
frames.cue: Return gently to the start and prepare for the next rep.

safety: Keep the feet grounded and avoid using momentum.
Maintain a neutral neck and lead with the chest rather than pulling the head.
Use a smaller lift or stop for sharp neck or lower-back pain.

aiCoachNote.prompt: How did Sit-Up Reach feel? Note neck or lower-back discomfort and how many controlled reps you completed.
